item.snowmen.rolled_snowball.hint: Place it on the ground or on a bigger snowball
item.snowmen.top_hat.hint: A snowman wearing it never melts
item.snowmen.scarf.hint: Put it on a snowman. Dye it any colour.
item.snowmen.santa_hat.hint: A snowman wearing it never melts

advancements.snowmen.root.title: Snowman
advancements.snowmen.root.description: Pack a snowball from snow with an empty hand
advancements.snowmen.snowman.title: A Cold Friend
advancements.snowmen.snowman.description: Stack three snowballs into a snowman
advancements.snowmen.big_snowball.title: Snowballing
advancements.snowmen.big_snowball.descri: Roll a snowball until it reaches size 16
advancements.snowmen.tall_snowman.title: Look Up
advancements.snowmen.tall_snowman.descri: Stack a snowman five snowballs tall
advancements.snowmen.fairy_lights.title: All Lit Up
advancements.snowmen.fairy_lights.descri: Wind fairy lights around a snowman
advancements.snowmen.dressed.title: Dressed for December
advancements.snowmen.dressed.description: Give a snowman eyes, a smile, a nose, three buttons, two arms, a scarf and a hat
advancements.snowmen.snowball_fight.desc: Hit a snowman with eyes and get a snowball back
snowmen.config.melting.desc: Snowmen and snowballs slowly melt in places where a snow golem would melt, like deserts and the Nether.
snowmen.config.ballSizeLimit.desc: How big a snowball can grow while rolling. 0 means no limit.
snowmen.config.maxStackHeight.desc: How many snowballs can be stacked. Three make a snowman; more make it taller.
snowmen.config.snowTrail.desc: Rolling a snowball picks up the snow it rolls over and leaves a trail of bare ground.
snowmen.config.rotateHint.desc: Show a hint above the hotbar when you stand next to a finished snowman.
snowmen.config.lightsChase.desc: Fairy lights on a snowman change colour one after another, like real Christmas lights.
snowmen.config.throwBack.desc: A snowman with eyes throws a snowball back when you hit it once.
snowmen.missing_mycel: Mycel is missing. %s needs the Mycel library to work and stays off until it is installed.
